integrity: Algebraic identities checked by supplied standalone SymPy script; global convergence and cycle existence follow from analytical planar arguments. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp theorem applies to the exact planar fast-x algebraic reduction, not the original 3D system or the fast-y reduction; no uniqueness of cycles below the threshold is claimed; older primary full texts could remain relevant to historical priority.
title: Sharp parameter-uniform oscillation cutoff for the fast-\(x\) Oregonator reduction
